name: @social-recall/extension
description: Chrome extension for Social Recall - save LinkedIn profiles with one click

scripts.build: npx esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts src/settings.ts src/voyager-interceptor.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --format=iife
scripts.watch: npx esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/popup.ts src/settings.ts src/voyager-interceptor.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --target=es2017 --format=iife --watch
